_comment: One entry per mos-geo-* skill. Adding a skill to the pack means adding it here and re-running build_template.py; the Checklist tab is generated from this list in this order.

skills.what_it_does: 360° brand intelligence report plus an AI Visibility Scorecard: does ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews know, find, cite and recommend the brand.

AI Info Page: an official, sourced fact sheet for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini (basic info, background, services, clients, methods, advantages, guidance for AI), with one schema file and a developer handover.
skills.needs: Client website URL (uses Brand Truth Review corrections when present)

skills.what_it_does: Fast AI Info Page draft in the exact shape of Steve Toth's GPT, written from the brand's own brain, site crawl and a short interview; a lint gate fails any missing section or any number not in those inputs.
skills.feeds_tab: None yet (page.md, page.html and handover.md live in the run folder)
skills.needs: Brand website URL; a MarketingOS brain if there is one

skills.what_it_does: 12 to 20 homepage FAQs written for AI assistants to quote: one self-contained sentence per answer, entity first, every fact from the brand's own site, each linked to the internal page that backs it up, with FAQPage schema and a client approval tab.
skills.needs: Brand name and website URL; Scrapling recommended (uses AI Info Page and Brand 360 outputs when present)

skills.what_it_does: Client-ready LLM share buttons package: brief, code reference and an in-brand demo of 'ask ChatGPT / Claude / Perplexity about this page' buttons.

Internal link audit (true contextual links vs template noise, orphans, deep pages, links to redirects and errors, anchor conflicts) plus reviewable contextual link recommendations: target, sentence and verbatim anchor, judged by TypeSafe Jev.
skills.feeds_tab: None yet (audit and recommendations live in the run folder)
skills.needs: Screaming Frog Internal HTML + All Inlinks exports and stored HTML (GSC columns optional); TypeSafe API key for judge/place

skills.what_it_does: Keyword clusters (one cluster = one page) rolled up into topics with a pillar, each mapped to the page ranking today, with status (Owned, Striking, Cannibalised, Lost ...), opportunity score, home-page overload and a cannibalisation list; pairs judged by TypeSafe Jev, clusters and numbers built in code.
skills.feeds_tab: None yet (xlsx and README live in the run folder)
skills.needs: Ahrefs Organic Keywords export or GSC page+query export; TypeSafe API key; OpenAI or Voyage key optional (embeddings); DataForSEO optional (SERP overlap)

skills.what_it_does: Live JSON-LD snapshot of every page from a Screaming Frog crawl (custom extraction or stored HTML, JavaScript rendered): one pure-JSON file per page ([] if none), sorted by page type, broken blocks flagged. The 'before' state for a schema rebuild.
skills.feeds_tab: None yet (outputs live in the schema folder)
skills.needs: Screaming Frog crawl with JavaScript rendering and a JSON-LD custom extraction (or stored HTML); Apify token only for the paid fallback

skills.what_it_does: Landscape Word brief: current schema audit plus the 3 to 5 highest-impact schemas, each with a developer template and an example filled with the brand's real values, unverified values raised as margin comments.
skills.feeds_tab: None yet (outputs live in the schema folder)
skills.needs: Screaming Frog structured data export (CSV), ideally from the same crawl as the scraper; Node 18+
